service.name: Blues and rock band
service.serviceType: Blues and rock covers for private and corporate events
service.description: Blues, classic rock and original material fronted by Tony Medina, booked from solo voice and guitar up to a four piece, for private and corporate events in Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.a: Blues and the rock and roll that came out of it, plus his own songs. The covers run from Freddie King and B.B. King through the classic rock of the seventies and the alternative rock of the nineties, and the footage on this page is him playing them. He's a Denver musician booked through Signet Artists, solo up to a four piece.

faqs.q: Will it fill a dance floor?
faqs.a: At trio and four piece, yes. It's voice and guitar over bass and drums, with a second guitar or keys on top at the four piece, playing blues and rock a crowd already knows.

Solo, it sits under the conversation, so a dinner table talks across it. The four piece on a dance floor plays like a rock band at a good party, and the band moves between the two on cue. He sets the level to the space and the crowd, and if your venue has a sound limit, give us the number.

faqs.q: Does he play originals at a private event?
faqs.a: Only if you want them. The default set for an event is covers, because guests dance to what they recognize. His own songs can sit inside the set where a night has space for them, which is worth asking about for a listening crowd.

video.name: Tony Medina live: blues and rock voice and guitar for private events in Denver
video.description: Tony Medina playing the Prince song Purple Rain on voice and acoustic guitar: the sound he brings to a milestone birthday, an office party or a rehearsal dinner.
